rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual way to say that you do not like something or someone.

example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 jyun4 seoi1

rows.note: Use this for a stronger, more personal aversion, closer to ‘hate’ than ordinary dislike.

example.english: I really dislike people who lie.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 zang1 jan4 dei6 gong2 daai6 waa6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a feeling of aversion or distaste.

example.english: I really dislike this kind of approach.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 zung2 zou6 faat3 hou2 faan2 gam2

rows.note: Use this for a particular thing someone dislikes, especially when discussing likes and dislikes.

example.traditional: 呢啲就係我唔鍾意嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 zau6 hai6 ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 ge3 je5
